fact: The government reported that at 25 October 2023, 439,333 of the DGI's 1,077,679 tax identifiers (40.76%) had been attached to an NPI, after the DGI matched its IFU file against the RNPP; the PReM-Bénin financing agreement ties disbursement to real-time IFU-NPI matching from a 68% baseline.
title: Bénin : 8 millions de dollars pour renforcer l'interconnexion des fichiers fiscaux et d'identification
